newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: A Brown sets record date for stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: A Brown sets record date for stock dividend.

text.p: Holding firm A Brown Co Inc said on Tuesday it had set July 25 as the record date for its 15 percent stock dividend.
The dividend will be taken from the unissued shares which will be distributed on August 8.

A Brown told the Philippine Stock Exchange it had not set a record date for the 10 percent stock dividend declared last month since the Securities and Exchange Commission has not approved its capital increase where the new shares will be sourced.
A Brown is engaged in real estate development, chemical manufacturing, consumer products distribution and agribusiness.
